{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high when prices are declining, requiring 1-3% daily downward correction",
    "When sentiment is negative (0.00-0.33), forecast values should be lowered by 2-4% to match mean reversion reality",
    "Sentiment positivity overestats prices when momentum is flat, apply 1-2% compression correction",
    "Discrepancy between model and history increases with forecast horizon, compress 0.1-0.3 daily for each day beyond day 5",
    "When history shows continuous decline over last 3+ days, start forecasts at history value and trend gently up instead of continuing decline",
    "Model exhibits lag on upside moves - when prices rise, forecasts should be 0.5-1.5% below where model would predict",
    "Mean reversion bias: when price deviates >2 from 18-day mean, forecasts must converge toward that mean"
] }
